When @becerraforgovernor announced he was running for Governor, I didn’t hesitate. I was one of the first elected officials in California to endorse him back in spring 2025, and I’d do it again without blinking, in a heartbeat.

Here’s why. 
As a Salvadoran immigrant who grew up watching families get left behind, I needed to know our next Governor had already been tested. Xavier has. He has stood up for us. He fought for healthcare when people in power wanted to take it away. His entire career has been about showing up and fighting for working families, immigrant communities, and people who just needed someone in their corner. This experience matters. 

This morning in San Francisco, I gave remarks at his final SF stop before June 2. And what struck me most was the various coalitions and groups of leaders that came out, from elected officials to our labor brothers and sisters in the room, It was the entire comunidad, showing up. Regular people who showed up on a Saturday morning because they care about the future of this state. That’s what this is all about.

California needs a Governor who has already proven what he’ll fight for. Experience matters. That’s Xavier. 

Vote for @xavierparagobernador . June 2. 

#BecerraEra #becerra

2025… what a year!

Serving as Mayor of South San Francisco was the honor of a lifetime. A year of cafécitos, community wins, big dreams, and even bigger teamwork. From celebrating our youth to hosting the largest cultural event in our city’s history, @culturafestofficial from immigrant rights workshops to strengthening our city’s future, every moment was powered by YOU.

As I close out my mayoral year and step into 2026, I’m carrying deep gratitude for this community that trusted me, challenged me, and inspired me every single day.

Here’s to the people who make South San Francisco the city it is: resilient, diverse, joyful, and always moving forward.

Gracias a mi gente y comunidad. Thank you for an unforgettable 2025. And above all things, all glory to God! 🙏

Let’s make 2026 even brighter!🌟💙🏙️

This morning, the steps of South San Francisco City Hall came alive with the voices and energy of hundreds of students as we kicked off Ruby Bridges Walk to School Day.

What began right here in South San Francisco has grown into a statewide recognition thanks to the leadership of Senator Josh Becker, @josh.becker.ca and now a national movement for justice, equity, and inclusion. 

I am deeply proud of the advocacy, organizing, and courage of our students and community leaders who made this possible. Ruby Bridges’ walk was a defining moment in history and today, our young people are carrying that legacy forward.

Here in South San Francisco, we don’t wait to lead. We step up when we see opportunities to advance justice, equity, and inclusion. That’s who we are. That’s what we stand for. 

Grateful for every partner, schools, families and teachers and every student, and every leader who walked with us today. Together, we are building a future rooted in courage and hope. 

#RubyBridgesWalk #SouthSanFrancisco #mayoreddie

📸✨ ¡Sí se pudo! This week we broke ground on a dream: The new Orange Clubhouse Complex right here in South San Francisco!

With golden shovels in hand and our community by our side, students, families, BGCP staff, elected leaders, and generous donors, we celebrated the start of a $27.3 MILLION investment in our youth. 

And here’s the best part: it’s already fully funded, thanks to the incredible generosity of partners like the Sobrato Family Foundation, Sand Hill Foundation, and so many others who believe in our kids and our city’s future.

This isn’t just a building. It’s a beacon. A promise that over 440+ SSF youth — from elementary through high school — will have access to expanded academic support, wellness services, career pathways, and a safe space to grow, dream, and lead!

To our partners: Hunter Properties, the South San Francisco City Council, and the visionary team at BGCP, thank you for your leadership and heart. 

Juntos, estamos construyendo un futuro lleno de esperanza y oportunidades. Together we are building a future filled with hope and opportunities. 

This is what happens when a city believes in its youth. When we honor legacy and invest in tomorrow. When we say, loud and clear: South San Francisco is building for the future, and the future is now.

Expected Completion Date: Spring 2027 

#OrangeClubhouse #BGCP #SouthSanFrancisco #boysandgirlsclub #MayorEddie

(Para leerlo en Español, seleccione aquí)
​
Hello friends and neighbors,
I’m Eddie Flores, your current South San Francisco councilmember representing District 5. I was appointed to this role in 2021, and elected by a supportive majority of residents to represent District 5 in South San Francisco in November 2022. It is the honor of my life to serve as your councilmember, and be elected by the voters of SSF District 5
As a teacher and mental health advocate, I have served this wonderful community I have called home for over 30 years. I have served as a Parks and Recreation Commissioner, SSFUSD School Board President and in the past 2 years as your councilmember. In this time, I’ve been fortunate to learn, live, and work with families all throughout our city for equity, social justice, a better quality of life, and additional educational opportunities.
South San Francisco has a unique and wonderful cultural ecosystem, and I have worked to celebrate our diversity and ensure that all residents, including immigrants like myself, are represented and supported in our city. I have and will continue to work hard to bring much needed support to our Old Town comunidad.
We have all endured much during this global pandemic. Despite those hardships, our city has proven its resilience. I have worked hard to support our local workers and residents who have suffered—passing hazard pay for our grocery store and retail workers, providing gift cards for local residents to support our local small businesses, and supporting a guaranteed basic income program to meet the basic needs of our residents.
I am dedicated to continuing my role as a city councilmember and strong advocate for the residents of District 5, our Old Town/downtown community, and our entire city of South San Francisco. Together we can develop solutions to tackle the various issues we face today, preserve and improve South City’s quality of life, and ensure that we all have a place to call home.
I invite you to sign up to stay connected and informed of what's happening in SSF District 5. Please feel free to reach out, if I or my team can be of service to you.
In service,
Eddie Flores
